semiconductor_relevance: High — Inabata & Co., Ltd. provides a range of semiconductor materials and equipment, making it a relevant player in the semiconductor supply chain.
summary: Inabata & Co., Ltd. offers a comprehensive portfolio of semiconductor materials, equipment, and technical solutions, leveraging a global supplier network. Their offerings include gas abatement systems, wafer-handling equipment, and semiconductor packaging materials, along with design services and supply-chain coordination.

regional_presence.India: Inabata & Co., Ltd. has a local presence in India to support its semiconductor solutions and services.
